$comment: Parameter docs written by Claude (AI) from the Nucleus and Proto Input source: what to pass for each parameter of the most used methods. Keys are members as handlers write them; basis says what each is based on. The tools show them as AI-written. scripts/generate-api.mjs puts them on the parameters (doc, docBy).

Context.GetFolder.basis: Nucleus GenericContext.cs GetFolder; FileUtil.cs GetFolder; GenericGameHandler.cs jsData; Folder.cs

params.folder: Nucleus.Folder.InstancedGameFolder (this instance's root folder once it is set up), MainGameFolder (the folder holding the game's exe) or Documents (the user's Documents folder).

params.path: Full path of the text file to search; it must exist (it is read without a check). Returns the first matching line number, counting from 1, or -1.
params.type: How a line must match: Nucleus.SearchType.Contains, Nucleus.SearchType.Full (the whole line equals searchValue) or Nucleus.SearchType.StartsWith.

ProtoInput.InstallHook.basis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs InstallHook, ExposedValues; PlayerInfo.cs ProtoInputInstanceHandle; ProtoInputLauncher.cs

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle); Nucleus sets it when it injects Proto Input, otherwise it is 0.
params.hookID: Which hook to install: a ProtoInput.Values.*HookID value, e.g. ProtoInput.Values.GetCursorPosHookID or ProtoInput.Values.FocusHooksHookID.

ProtoInput.UninstallHook.basis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs UninstallHook, ExposedValues; PlayerInfo.cs ProtoInputInstanceHandle

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).
params.hookID: Which hook to remove: a ProtoInput.Values.*HookID value, the same one passed to InstallHook.

ProtoInput.EnableMessageFilter.basis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs EnableMessageFilter, ExposedValues; PlayerInfo.cs ProtoInputInstanceHandle

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).
params.filterID: Which filter to turn on: a ProtoInput.Values.*FilterID value, e.g. ProtoInput.Values.RawInputFilterID or ProtoInput.Values.WindowActivateFilterID.

ProtoInput.DisableMessageFilter.basis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs DisableMessageFilter, ExposedValues; PlayerInfo.cs ProtoInputInstanceHandle

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).
params.filterID: Which filter to turn off: a ProtoInput.Values.*FilterID value, the same one passed to EnableMessageFilter.

Context.ModifySaveFile.basis: Nucleus GenericContext.cs ModifySaveFile; SaveType.cs; SaveData/IniSaveInfo.cs, CfgSaveInfo.cs

params.installSavePath: Full path of the source file to read. For INI it is copied to saveFullPath first when the two paths differ (the copy fails if saveFullPath already exists).
params.saveFullPath: Full path where the edited file is written; may be the same as installSavePath to edit in place.
params.type: File format: Nucleus.SaveType.INI or Nucleus.SaveType.CFG (Source-engine style cfg); any other value throws.
params.info: One or more entries to set, new Nucleus.IniSaveInfo(section, key, value) for INI or new Nucleus.CfgSaveInfo(section, key, value) for CFG; other kinds are ignored.

params.baseKey: Registry root as text: "HKEY_CURRENT_USER", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE" or "HKEY_USERS"; anything else and the call does nothing.
params.sKey: Key path under the root, e.g. "Software\\Company\\Game"; created if missing. Before the first edit Nucleus exports it to utils\backup\<last part>.reg.
params.subKey: Name of the value to set inside that key.
params.value: The data to write; null does nothing. For RegType.Binary the value's text is stored as UTF-8 bytes.
params.regType: Value type: Nucleus.RegType.String, DWord, QWord, Binary, ExpandString or MultiString (the names of .NET's RegistryValueKind).

params.path: Full path of the text file to edit; it must exist. The file is read, deleted and written back.
params.newLines: Array of "N|new text" strings: N is the line number, counting from 1; out-of-range lines are skipped and text after a second | is dropped.
params.encoder: Encoding name for .NET Encoding.GetEncoding, e.g. "utf-8" or "utf-16", used to read and write; without it .NET's default (UTF-8) is used.

Game.AddOption.basis: Nucleus GenericGameInfo.cs AddOption; GameOption.cs; PlayerOptionsControl.cs; GameProfile.cs

params.name: Title of the option shown to the player in Nucleus' options list.
params.key: Name the handler reads the chosen value with: Context.Options[key].
params.value: Default value or choices: an array of choices shows a drop-down (first item preselected); an empty array shows a text box.
params.defaultValue: Stored on the option, but no Nucleus code reads it; a drop-down starts on the first item of value.

params.path: Full path of the file to write; an existing file is deleted first, so its old content is lost.
params.lines: The text: one or more lines, as separate arguments or an array; each becomes a line, with no line break after the last.

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).
params.enable: true draws Proto Input's fake mouse cursor in that instance, false hides it.

ProtoInput.StartFocusMessageLoop.basis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs StartFocusMessageLoop; ProtoInputLoader Inject.cpp; ProtoInputHooks FocusMessageLoop.cpp

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).
params.milliseconds: Pause between rounds of fake focus messages, in milliseconds.
params.wm_activate: true posts WM_ACTIVATE (click-activate) to the game window each round.
params.wm_activateapp: true posts WM_ACTIVATEAPP (activated) to the game window each round.
params.wm_ncactivate: true posts WM_NCACTIVATE (active title bar) to the game window each round.
params.wm_setfocus: true posts WM_SETFOCUS to the game window each round.
params.wm_mouseactivate: true posts WM_MOUSEACTIVATE to the game window each round.

params.path: Full path of the XML file; %VARIABLES% are expanded. The file is saved in place.
params.xpath: XPath selecting the element(s) to change, e.g. "//Settings/Width"; every match is changed.
params.innerTextValue: New text content for each matched element (replaces everything inside it).

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).

Context.RunAdditionalFiles.basis: Nucleus GenericContext.cs RunAdditionalFiles (all three overloads); GameManager.cs GetAppContentPath

params.filePaths: Array of full file paths. Plain paths run for the first player only; prefix "N|" (player number from 1) or "all|" for every player.
params.changeWorkingDir: true starts each file in the AdditionalFiles folder of Nucleus' content folder; false in the file's own folder.
params.secondsToPauseInbetween: Seconds to wait between files (not after the last); in the overloads with promptBetween, only when promptBetween is true.
params.runAsAdmin: true starts each file as administrator (Windows asks for elevation).
params.promptBetween: true shows a prompt after each file that waits for OK before going on.
params.showFilePath: true adds the file's path to the prompt text.
params.confirm: true starts each file only after its prompt is confirmed; files then only run when promptBetween is also true.

params.originalFile: Full path of the file to read.
params.patchedFile: Full path the patched bytes are written to; may be the same as originalFile. It is written even if nothing matched.
params.patchFind: Bytes to find, as an array of numbers 0-255; only the first match is patched (more matches are logged as not unique).
params.patchReplace: Bytes written over the match, starting at its first byte.
params.spatchFind: Text to find, converted to ASCII bytes; only the first match is patched.
params.spatchReplace: Text written over the match as ASCII bytes, starting at its first byte.

params.baseKey: Registry root as text: "HKEY_CURRENT_USER", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE" or "HKEY_USERS"; anything else and the call does nothing.
params.sKey: Key path under the root, e.g. "Software\\Company\\Game"; created if missing. No .reg backup is made.
params.subKey: Name of the value to set inside that key.
params.value: The data to write; null does nothing. For RegType.Binary the value's text is stored as UTF-8 bytes.
params.regType: Value type: Nucleus.RegType.String, DWord, QWord, Binary, ExpandString or MultiString (the names of .NET's RegistryValueKind).

params.path: Full path of the XML file; %VARIABLES% are expanded. The file is saved in place.
params.xpath: XPath selecting the element(s) whose attribute to change, e.g. "//Graphics"; every match is changed.
params.attributeName: Name of an existing attribute on every matched element; a match without it throws.

params.originalFile: Full path of the file to read.
params.patchedFile: Full path the patched bytes are written to; may be the same as originalFile.
params.origPattern: Bytes to find as a hex string, spaces allowed, e.g. "8B 45 FC 89"; no wildcards.
params.patchPattern: Replacement bytes as a hex string, at least as long as origPattern, written over each match byte by byte.
params.insert: Number whose low two bytes (little-endian) are written into a copy of origPattern at offset, which then replaces the match.
params.offset: Position in origPattern, counting bytes from 1, where the two insert bytes go.
params.patchall: With patchPattern: true patches every match fully, false only the first byte of each match. With insert: false stops after the first match.

ProtoInput.SetRawInputBypass.basis: Nucleus ProtoInput.cs SetRawInputBypass; ProtoInputHooks RawInput.cpp, PipeCommunication.cpp; readme Proto Input.txt

params.instanceHandle: The player's Proto Input instance, Player.ProtoInputInstanceHandle (or PlayerList[i].ProtoInputInstanceHandle).
params.enable: true passes raw input from every device to the game, not just the player's; false lets Proto Input filter it per device.

Context.CopyFolder.basis: Nucleus GenericContext.cs CopyFolder; FileUtil.cs CopyDirectory, CopyDirectoryFiles

params.source: Full path of the folder to copy, with all its subfolders.
params.destination: Full path of the target folder, created if missing; files already there are not overwritten (copy errors are ignored).

params.DestinationPath: Full path to copy the handler's own folder (handlers\<handler file name>\) into, with subfolders; created if missing, existing files overwritten.

params.filePaths: Array of full file paths; each existing file is copied to <name>_NUCLEUS_BACKUP<ext> in the same folder, missing ones are logged.
params.filePath: Full path of one file to copy to <name>_NUCLEUS_BACKUP<ext> beside it; this overload only acts for the first player.
params.overwrite: true replaces an existing _NUCLEUS_BACKUP copy; false and the copy already exists throws.

params.path: Full path of the text file to edit; it must exist. The file is read, deleted and written back.
params.newLines: Array of "N|regex|replacement" strings: N is the line number from 1, every regex match on that line is replaced (.NET Regex.Replace); none may contain |.
params.encoder: Encoding name for .NET Encoding.GetEncoding, e.g. "utf-8" or "utf-16", used to read and write; without it .NET's default (UTF-8) is used.
